statement: Axeyum executes the exact printed A0, RV64I, and x86-64 absolute-value programs and checks typed state relations at every applicable synchronization point for ten declared inputs.
scope: Ten distinct 64-bit boundary and branch-shape inputs; the entry, decision, optional negative update, and exit points; concrete modular absolute value; the mathematical-positive interpretation excludes signed minimum.
exclusions: A universal theorem over all 64-bit words
Timing, concurrency, virtual memory, permissions, and devices

negative_control.mutates: Change the x86 signed branch from JNS to JE while retaining the same typed relation checker

limitations: This is finite executable evidence, not a proof over every 64-bit input.
The relation is specific to the printed absolute-value routine and selected teaching profiles.
The signed-minimum case supports only modular absolute value, not a positive signed mathematical result.
